column1: # Autodesk R13 install-disc drawings, measured locally and never fetched in CI or committed (Griffin, 2026-10-26: the licence is unclear).
# One row per distinct drawing (sha256) of the 263 AC1012 drawings on five disc images, as the directories of the hunt name them: archive.org item/file.
# Columns: sha256 and size of the drawing; locator records; bytes 0x06-0x0C; code page; header variable slots; the bits that end the last slot's byte; whole header bytes after the last slot;
# the bitmap entry of section 14.2 in bytes; the four bytes after AC1012 in section 26; the disc images that hold it. ARCHITECTURE.md 7aj says what the rows show.
